title: Gilded Memories

outfit_card.silhouette: A regal off-shoulder gown with a structured corseted bodice, voluminous tiered skirt, and sheer draped cape sleeves. Layered gold lace and organza create an asymmetrical, aristocratic elegance.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An intricate gold filigree tiara with cascading chains and green gemstone drops, accompanied by a delicate forehead chain and trailing vine-like hairpins.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Off-shoulder bodice in gilded silk jacquard with crystal-embellished lace appliqué, a high sheer lace choker collar, and draped tulle sleeves with gold embroidery and pearl fringing.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A multi-tiered golden skirt with pleated organza, tulle overlays, and lace trim. The hem features floral embroidery and pearl accents, paired with matching gold heeled boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden petals, delicate light particles, and a small ornate hand fan or jewelry box, with leaf and vine motifs woven into the lace and embroidery.
